For business

Give the busywork to an agent.

Inbox triage, scheduling, follow-ups, research: the work that eats a small team’s week, handled by agents your whole team can message.

Which one is this?

A team · you are here

Up to 50 agents, and any of them can answer your whole team. $99 a month, or $999 a year.

One person

Free on your own AI account for one agent, no card. That is Archie for Personal: up to 10 agents for $30 a month or $299 a year, and each one answers you. Same app to learn, same computer it runs on.

What your agent handles

The work that slows a small team down.

None of it is hard. All of it takes time. An agent does the repetitive middle; your team touches the part that needs a person.

Inbox & Customer TriageSorts what needs you now, drafts the rest
Client Follow-upsPrepares check-ins so nobody slips through
Scheduling & RemindersSuggests slots, drafts confirmations
Research & Supplier LookupsCompares options into a short list
Meeting RecapsCaptures decisions and action items
Reports & SummariesPulls from your tools into a status update
Archie for Business

Agents your whole team can message.

A personal Archie agent answers one person: its owner. A business one answers everybody the owner lets in, and that is the whole difference between the editions. Each person is answered from their own mail and calendar, never anybody else’s.

Archie for Business installs beside the personal Archie as its own app, with its own data and keys. The full plan, side by side with the personal one.

The other way: an agent per person

Or an agent per teammate, all in the same app.

Some teams want a desk per person instead of one shared desk. The same app does that: an agent per teammate, shaped to their role, beside the one everybody shares, with room for an agent per department, up to 50. The switch on the drawing above shows it.

Shaped to each role. Support gets an agent that triages the inbox and drafts replies. The owner gets one that chases follow-ups and preps the weekly numbers. Each asks about the business, then fits its Add-ons: Skills it can use, Routines it runs on a schedule, a Personality it answers in.

Customer lists, invoices, inboxes: your business data stays on your computer, and our servers hold each account’s email and plan, never a conversation. An email goes out only when you send it or set a time, a change to a calendar you’ve connected is proposed to you before it happens, and it cannot spend money or buy anything at all. The whole list, on the trust page →

And if Archie can’t do it yet, tell us and we’ll build the add-on. It becomes a marketplace listing, so the one we build for you helps the next business.

Consulting

Don’t know where to start? That’s the part we do with you.

Most owners don’t need convincing that some of this would help. They need to know which parts, in what order. That is consulting: a free 30-minute call, the scope in writing before you book anything, then the build in phases. If the plan needs something the marketplace doesn’t have yet, building it is part of the job.

How Consulting Works →
Guided setup

Rather have us walk your team through setup?

You can set this up yourself, and Archie is built for that. Plenty of owners would rather not the first time: we build the agents with you on the computer that will run them, connect accounts with your approval, and fine-tune after launch. The steps are on How It Works; the three costs below are the whole list.

Guided sessions

$250 a session, an hour each. A bigger setup takes more sessions, never a higher rate. We scope how many on the free call.

Archie

$99 a month or $999 a year, one plan covering every agent the team runs, with no seat count and separate from guided setup. Archie is in testing. The waitlist hears the day it opens. See where it stands →

The AI model

AI usage is billed directly to the business’s own provider account. Costs are measured per agent: a shared agent adds up the whole team’s use. See the light, moderate and heavy estimates on Pricing.
